comparisons.name: empty-trash-light
comparisons.description: Finder's Empty Trash alert, the whole window capture with its shadow, Aqua. The Trash icon is Apple's artwork: the example leaves the icon area empty and the mask covers it.

comparisons.name: empty-trash-light-layout
comparisons.description: As empty-trash-light with the message, the informative text and the button titles masked as well, to score the frame, the shadow, the title bar and the buttons' drawing alone: text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.
